subtitle: Markdown drafts with reviewed GitHub saves
description: Write Markdown with the Rinx article writer layout, icon controls and preview in a compatible OctoSense host. Keep recoverable drafts locally; connect GitHub through host OAuth, select a repository and file, and review exact Markdown before committing. Requires the connected-services host build. Live OAuth and remote commits remain unverified; screenshots show fictional native UI fixtures.
release_notes: Development sample: Rinx writer layout, local draft recovery and synthetic GitHub review validated on macOS; local Android editing verified in a separate test app. Not published; live provider acceptance remains pending.
